metadata.purpose: Checksums of the data the paper evaluated. scripts/hard3dbench/prepare_ood.py compares a prepared Out-of-Distribution root with them. Hashes only; no image, depth or camera values.
metadata.cameras_sha256: sha256 of <dataset>/cameras.json as prepare_ood.py writes it: JSON with sorted keys, indent 1, floats rounded with round(x, 6), no NaN, and a trailing newline
metadata.files: sha256 of the decoded array bytes (C order, little-endian) of every image and depth file, by path relative to the Out-of-Distribution root
metadata.decode: *.npy: numpy.load(path). ETH3D ground_truth_depth/*.JPG: numpy.fromfile(path, '<f4'), a raw float32 dump. All other files: numpy.asarray(PIL.Image.open(path)), which gives uint8 HxWx3 RGB images and uint16 HxW arrays for 16-bit PNG depth (32-bit mode I arrays from older Pillow are cast to uint16)
